distance_method: Resolve figure/table labels to named PDF destinations from the corresponding aux file and inspect PDF hyperlink annotations; page gap equals caption page minus earliest linked reference page. Same-page top floats count as zero gap.
scientific_evidence_scope: No new experiments or measurements; table cells, captions, equations, prose, headings, citation keys, graphic assets and graphic display widths preserved.

official_template_source.scope: Caption position, readability and existing two-column formatting; no template or submission-policy migration.

visual_review.outcome: Overview and result figures reviewed beside their explanations; column widths, caption placement, paired timing tables and final full-width panel checked. No clipping, missing glyphs, unreadable table content or overlap observed. Chinese result figures use positions appropriate to the shorter translated text.

layout_choices.overview: Queue the unchanged full-width overview before Related Work so it can open the English Method page; verify actual PDF location within one page of Method opening.
layout_choices.main_results: English wide result figures queued at experiment opening; Chinese result figures follow their corresponding results paragraphs.
layout_choices.short_supplement_tables: S12/S15 use single-column floats with unchanged grid content and font; tables S23/S24 share a wide float as two minipages with separate captions and numbering.
layout_choices.final_panel: Use the native full-width twocolumn top block for the unchanged enlargement, with references in the remaining columns below.
